title: Rathkit build
description: Builds a project with rkp bundle.

entry.description: The entry or entries, relative to the project root. Default: index.html, else src/main.* or src/index.*.

format.description: esm, cjs or iife; a list (or esm,cjs) builds both in one run.

target.description: es2015 ... es2025, esnext, or engines such as chrome80,safari13.1.

external.description: Packages left out of the bundle.

define.description: Constants replaced in the code, KEY to VALUE.

loader.description: File extension to loader, such as .svg to file.

config.description: A rathkit config file, relative to the workspace root. Default: rathkit.config.* in the project.

tsconfig.description: A tsconfig file, relative to the workspace root.

publicPath.description: The public path of copied files.

args.description: Further rkp arguments, passed as written.

rkpBin.description: The rkp program, relative to the workspace root. Default: the @rathkit/pack package, or RATHKIT_PACK_BIN.

outputPath.description: Where the build is written, relative to the workspace root. Default: dist in the project.

watch.description: Build again when a file changes, until stopped.

metafile.description: Write rkp's metafile (every module read and file written) to this path, relative to the workspace root. Keep it outside outputPath if the output is cached and compared across checkouts.

dtsBundle.description: With dts, one declaration file per entry.

library.description: Library mode: the entry is src/index.*, and several formats are written.
